svg.title: Queue implemented using two stacks
svg.desc: Diagram showing enqueue operations using stack1 and dequeue by transferring to stack2, achieving FIFO behavior
svg.text: Enqueue: A, B, C → push to Stack 1
Enqueue(x): always push to Stack 1. Time = O(1)
Dequeue: if Stack 2 is empty → pop all from Stack 1 and push to Stack 2 → then pop Stack 2
Dequeue time: O(n) worst case, O(1) amortized
Key insight: reversing twice = original order → achieves FIFO using two LIFOs
